summary: Ubisoft Annecy's open-world extreme-sports games, from the Alps-focused winter sports of Steep to Riders Republic's larger multi-sport parks and mass multiplayer structure.

entries.title: Riders Republic
entries.definitive_edition: Windows PC release with owned DLC/add-ons

emulation.notes: Run natively on Windows with current Ubisoft Connect build and owned add-ons.

primary.why: Riders Republic released for Windows, PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Stadia, Xbox One, Xbox Series X/S, and public platform summaries also list Amazon Luna. Windows is the highest-fidelity and most flexible route for the multi-sport open world, including post-launch add-ons such as skateboarding where owned.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows PC version at the highest stable settings with owned DLC/add-ons installed; use PS5/Xbox Series X/S as strong console alternatives.
